an5.168:1.1: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi …pe…
an5.168:1.2: dussīlassa āvuso sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti sammāsamādhi
an5.168:1.3: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an5.168:1.4: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatupaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an5.168:1.5: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ
an5.168:1.7: tassa papaṭikāpi na pāripūriṃ gacchati tacopi pheggupi sāropi na pāripūriṃ gacchati
an5.168:1.8: evameva kho āvuso dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti sammāsamādhi
an5.168:1.9: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an5.168:1.10: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatupaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an5.168:1.11: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an5.168:2.1: sīlavato āvuso sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi
an5.168:2.2: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an5.168:2.3: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an5.168:2.4: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ
an5.168:2.5: seyyathāpi āvuso rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno tassa papaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ gacchati tacopi pheggupi sāropi pāripūriṃ gacchati
an5.168:2.6: evameva kho āvuso sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi
an5.168:2.7: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an5.168:2.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an5.168:2.9: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassananti.
